Name: SleepyGenasi's Seasonal Taller Characters
Author: SleepyGenasi
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Tired of lumbering over the characters in your game? Are you vertically disadvantaged in real life like me and feel weird looking down at your spouse in game? This mod is a Seasonal Portraits and sprites mod to make your characters taller than the player model (Except for the children). Never look down into the eyes of shane, or feel giant next to Penny. Be the petite player you were born to be. [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Some fun features! Gives Abigail her Guinea pig in summer. Lets Emily bring her parrot to the beach. Sebastian catches frogs. Gives Kent a limp. Evelyn and George match outfits. Plus some fun additions for special dialogue![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Simply install this mod as you would any other![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Makes characters taller and makes portraits cuter[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requires Content Patcher and Smapi[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Say thanks to anyone who inspired or helped you.[/color][/size]
